name: AI Image Alt Text Generator – Imagerr AI
author: Netrr

sections.description:
This plugin uses AI to generate alt text, titles, descriptions, and captions for your images automatically. It improves your accessibility and SEO.

By Imagerr.ai.

Important: This plugin comes with a Free Trial: You will get some free credits to test the plugin out. However, to use it further, you will need to purchase a credits package.

No setup required – Imagerr AI uses its own built-in ChatGPT API access. You don’t need your own API key.

Besides the image Alt text, this plugin can generate the following too:
– Image Title
– Image Caption
– Image Description

The Imagerr AI plugin has been developed to work specifically with WordPress. It works with any WordPress theme or page builder. You can also use it apart from WordPress, through its web app.

Using this plugin, an ALT text will be generated for your WordPress media library image(s) with just one click or automatically when the images are uploaded. You can also generate the ALT texts in bulk for all your images.

New: With the “Replace on posts” option during Bulk Generation, the plugin will now search for each image across all post types (including Elementor and Divi content) and automatically update its alt text everywhere it’s used — not just in the media library. This ensures that reused images always show the most accurate and updated alt text across your entire website.
This is a unique feature that sets Imagerr AI apart from other similar plugins.

The plugin uses the modern Chat GPT integration (no setup needed), which generates high-quality, accurate alt texts for all your photos and images.

Besides SEO, nice descriptive image ALT texts are essential for a good accessibility score of your WordPress website or blog. With this plugin, you can take advantage of this.

Plugin Features:

  • Free Trial
  • Powered by ChatGPT (no API key required)
  • Generate Image Titles
  • Generate Image Captions
  • Generate Image Descriptions
  • Add SEO Keywords
  • Multilingual (supports more than 130 languages and locales around the world)
  • Bulk Alt Texts
  • Alt Texts on Images Upload
  • Replace on Posts (updates alt text across all post types, including Elementor & Divi)
  • SEO-Friendly
  • Improve Your Accessibility Score

This plugin works with any WordPress theme and page builder.
sections.installation:
1. Search for the plugin in the WordPress plugin directory in your WP admin dashboard
  2. Click “Install Now” and after that activate the plugin
  3. Create an account on Imagerr.ai to get some free credits
  4. Adjust the plugin settings in WP admin panel in “Imagerr AI > Settings”
sections.faq:
What does the Imagerr AI plugin do?

It automatically generates ALT texts, titles, descriptions, and captions for images in your WordPress media library using AI. The generated metadata improves both SEO and accessibility.

Do I need my own OpenAI API key?

No. The plugin includes its own built-in ChatGPT API access, so you can start generating metadata without configuring an external key.

Can the plugin work in languages other than English?

Yes. Imagerr AI supports more than 130 languages and locales, allowing you to generate metadata for multilingual sites automatically.

How does bulk generation work?

You can select many images (hundreds or thousands if needed) and run a bulk operation. The UI shows the number of images processed and the credits consumed, and you can stop the process midway if required.

Is there a way to customize the generated text?

Absolutely. You can add custom prefixes and suffixes, as well as SEO keywords, in the settings, letting you enforce brand-specific phrasing or style guidelines without editing each image manually.

Does the plugin integrate with popular SEO plugins?

Yes. It can pull focus key phrases from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, and Squirrly SEO, and incorporates them naturally into the ALT text.

How are credits priced and can I test the plugin for free?

The service runs on a credit-based model. New users receive 10 free AI credits to try the plugin straight away. After that you can purchase additional credit bundles that fit your volume needs.

Where can I find detailed documentation and support?

Full documentation is available at imagerr.ai/documentation-wp. For plugin-specific help, visit the WordPress.org support tab on the plugin page.

Can I use the AI generator outside of WordPress?

Yes. While the plugin is built for WordPress, the same AI engine is accessible via the standalone web app at imagerr.ai, so you can generate metadata for non-WordPress projects as well.

What browsers and WordPress versions are supported?

The plugin works with any modern browser and is compatible with all current WordPress releases. It also integrates seamlessly with any theme or page builder.
